{{Quote|Reeven Clan, our land is threatened! Crush the invaders!|translated=1|Jannik the White|<ref name="Starfighter: Crossbones">''[[Star Wars: Starfighter: Crossbones]]''</ref>}}
'''Reeven Clan''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] clan under the leadership of [[Jannik (Rodian)|Jannik the White]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]], Jannik and his clan fought an honor duel against [[Evo (Rodian)|Evo]] the Blue's [[Cairn Clan]]. They won due to the actions of [[Nym/Legends|Nym]], who had been hired by Jannik. Members of the clan then went on to help Nym in [[Gender/Legends|his]] adventure on [[Maramere]].<ref name="Starfighter: Crossbones" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], two members of the clan, [[Ralia Reeven|Ralia]] and [[Rei Reeven]], were part of Nym's [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]].<ref name="SWG:SM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Save Me|Lok}}</ref>
